title: Couscous Salad with Chicken and Apricots
description: A nutritious couscous salad featuring chicken, apricots, fresh herbs, and pistachios, designed for performance nutrition.

ingredients.name: chicken breasts
ingredients.preparation: rub with cayenne pepper, paprika, garlic powder

ingredients.name: fresh apricots
ingredients.preparation: pitted and cut into bite-size chunks

instructions.text: Place the couscous in a medium bowl.
Bring 1 1/2 cups water to a boil and stir in the cinnamon, cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper. Pour the mixture over the couscous.
Cover and let stand until the couscous is soft, about 5 minutes. Uncover and fluff with a fork.
Stir in the parsley, mint, and 2 tablespoons of the olive oil. Set aside.

Mix spices such as salt, pepper, cayenne, paprika, garlic powder, to taste and rub on chicken. Place chicken in oven or on grill and cook, flipping once. Cut into bite-size pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Add the apricots, shallot, and pistachios.

Drizzle with the vinegar and the remaining olive oil. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Divide the couscous among 6 dinner plates. Arrange the chicken salad over the couscous. If you want to get fancy garnish with the parsley sprigs and serve.
